episode_row: DD leg never entered after a single alert (cost +1)

commits.subject: fix(cli): check-pick-entered closes the loop — alerted is non-terminal (audit F1)
commits.body:
One DM then blindness let 7/08's DD leg go unentered past a single 18:00
alert, and 7/09's entry landed only after an out-of-band warning. v3: after
alerting, every */15 run RE-VERIFIES the account until confirmed or cutoff;
throttled escalations at T-30/T-15 minutes-to-cutoff (each tier at most once,
an alert at/below a threshold consumes it); a one-time all-clear DM on the
alerted->confirmed transition; failed DMs stay retryable at every tier;
legacy markers (no escalation ledger) treated as initial-fired. New
pick_entry health source backstops the audit trail at EOD: alerted past
cutoff = WARN, dm_failed past cutoff = CRITICAL, quiet while a late game's
window is still open.

commits.subject: feat(cli): check-pick-entered v2 — pending entries via GET api/predictions
commits.body:
v1 (2026-06-12) was disabled the night it shipped: its only source, the
user-profile predictions array, is SETTLED-only, so the pre-pitch check
false-alarmed every day. The app JS bundle revealed Api.Prediction.get ->
GET api/predictions, which exposes the OWN pending same-day row (verified
live tonight: the in-flight pick with result null). v2 detects entry from
the UNION of the profile and pending sources; any fetch failure skips
quietly WITHOUT consuming the once-per-day marker, so a transient error
cannot reproduce the v1 false-alarm class — the next 15-min cron run
retries. Closes the 2026-06-11 missed-entry incident class.
